column3: “Too sacred” supplies why the words cannot be spoken.
The final repeated purpose against conceit is omitted.
The Lord is made the explicit agent taking it away.
BSB’s “My” before “power” matches the Textus Receptus (μου).
“True” is supplied before marks; the second list explains the marks.
“My money and myself” supplies the objects of spending; being spent becomes actively spending himself; the condition becomes a question.
The passive finding of the speaker becomes the audience actively finding him.
